title: Audit a Bayesian regression model

stages.title: Exact posterior and density
stages.evidence: Model statement, posterior derivation, independent NumPy oracle and gradient check
stages.expected: PASS stage 1: posterior oracle, non-centered/rank-deficient data, log density, derivatives, input contracts
stages.diagnosis: Check target shape and scale versus variance conventions before changing the solver.

stages.title: Sampler and diagnostic audit
stages.evidence: Four traces, seeded replay, exact moment comparison, signed energy errors and classical split R-hat
stages.expected: PASS stage 2: two-seed moments, replay, changed keys, R-hat oracle, stuck and unstable chains
stages.diagnosis: Inspect leapfrog half steps, retained rejected states and independent key ownership.

stages.title: Predictive uncertainty and mismatch
stages.evidence: Latent versus observation variance plot, simulation check and shifted-outcome diagnosis
stages.expected: PASS stage 3: independent predictive variance, noise simulation, extrapolation, shifted-outcome check
stages.diagnosis: Separate full weight covariance from noise variance; inspect systematic residuals before tuning inference.

rubric: State a prior, likelihood and known-noise assumption
Derive the conjugate posterior and verify independent numerical references
Check gradients before tuning an HMC sampler
Record replay, changed-seed behavior and retained rejected states
Explain classical split R-hat and its limitations
Separate latent uncertainty from observation noise
Diagnose deliberate model mismatch and avoid real-data calibration claims
setupNote: Extract the ZIP into a fresh folder. Its top folder contains requirements-cpu.txt and projects/bayesian-regression; run commands from that top folder in the activated environment.
